<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 147.00 ppm (1 carbon), 133.90 ppm (1 carbon), 128.91 ppm (appears twice, indicating 2 carbons), and 127.68 ppm (appears twice, indicating 2 carbons). Summing these gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
